name: ikemen-zss-tools
description: A cohesive visual creation, project, team, testing, and release workspace for IKEMEN GO.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Browser and virtual workspaces receive portable text-language tools, documentation, capability reporting, and honest SFF/SND placeholders. Archive parsing and native executables remain disabled until separately implemented and verified.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Text navigation and inspection remain available; native builders, launchers, and external applications require a trusted local workspace.

ikemenZss.paletteBackgroundColor.description: Protected RGB color used for palette index 0 during provisional CS preparation. #00F5BA is the JNP standard; other projects may configure their own.

ikemenZss.paletteBackgroundSimilarityThr.description: RGB-distance guard around the protected palette background. Visible sprite colors inside this range receive unique provisional replacements so they cannot be confused with transparency.

enumDescriptions: ACT file order: first stored RGB color is index 0.
Reversed Photoshop method: reverse the 256 RGB entries when moving between ACT and SFF index order.
ikemenZss.actPaletteOrder.description: Remembered ACT import/export table convention. ACT files contain no reliable producer identity, so each preview can override this choice.

ikemenZss.openIkemenToolsOnStartup.description: Open the IKEMaker activity-bar panel after VS Code finishes restoring its window. Disable this to retain Explorer or the previously active sidebar.

ikemenZss.extensionUpdates.enabled.description: Allow a startup availability check when the configured interval has elapsed. Updates are never downloaded or installed without explicit review and approval.

ikemenZss.extensionUpdates.feedUrl.description: Reviewed HTTPS manifest for IKEMaker updates. The beta feed selects exact immutable packages rather than GitHub's latest-release alias.

ikemenZss.extensionUpdates.intervalHours.description: Minimum number of hours between automatic availability checks.

ikemenZss.extensionUpdates.trustedAssetH.description: Additional HTTPS hosts allowed for exact update assets. The feed host is always allowed; downloaded bytes must also match the published size and SHA-256.

ikemenZss.extensionUpdates.maxDownloadMB.description: Hard download-size ceiling for an IKEMaker VSIX update.

ikemenZss.authorName.description: Default author name used by reviewed character starter creation.

ikemenZss.productionWorkflow.actor.description: Team name recorded on workflow and ticket updates. When empty, the configured author name is used; otherwise updates use the neutral label Team member.

ikemenZss.mutationBackups.description: Create compact hidden backups before direct visual-editor and generated-profile writes.
ikemenZss.mutationBackups.deprecationMessage: Automatic backups have been removed. Use Make Backup instead.

ikemenZss.mutationHistory.description: Record direct visual-editor writes in .ikemen-tools/mutations.json with hashes and backup locations.

ikemenZss.mutationHistoryLimit.description: Maximum direct-write history entries retained per mutation root.

ikemenZss.experience.zss.description: ZSS presentation level. Learning adds guidance and explanations; Advanced favors compact and bulk-oriented workflows without removing help.

ikemenZss.experience.lua.description: Lua presentation level for IKEMEN frontend, module, and hook authoring.

ikemenZss.experience.cns.description: CNS presentation level, configured independently from ZSS and Lua.

ikemenZss.experience.assets.description: SFF, AIR, SND, and palette presentation level.

ikemenZss.story.portraitGroup.description: Project-configurable suggested SFF group for native Dialogue portraits. Indices 0-19 are presented as reaction slots; this is a workflow convention, not an IKEMEN requirement.

zssNavigator.showWorkspaceFiles.description: Show all workspace ZSS files below the active file in ZSS Navigator.

ikemenZss.mapPrefix.deprecationMessage: Use ikemenZss.mapPrefixes to allow multiple project namespaces.
ikemenZss.mapPrefix.description: Legacy single allowed map prefix. Empty disables it.

ikemenZss.functionPrefix.deprecationMessage: Use ikemenZss.functionPrefixes to allow multiple project namespaces.
ikemenZss.functionPrefix.description: Legacy single allowed function prefix. Empty disables it.

ikemenZss.mapPrefixes.description: Allowed prefixes for project-owned map names. Leave empty for no prefix warnings. Configure per workspace or workspace folder to tie rules to a project.

ikemenZss.functionPrefixes.description: Allowed prefixes for project-owned ZSS function names. Leave empty for no prefix warnings. Configure per workspace or workspace folder to tie rules to a project.

ikemenZss.generatedSymbolPrefix.description: Prefix used by generated guard-proximity and hit-reaction helper symbols. Configure per workspace or workspace folder.

ikemenZss.guardHelperSymbolPrefix.description: Optional guard-helper-specific prefix. Empty uses generatedSymbolPrefix.

ikemenZss.hitReactionSymbolPrefix.description: Optional hit-reaction-helper-specific prefix. Empty uses generatedSymbolPrefix.

ikemenZss.maxAuditFiles.description: Maximum workspace ZSS files scanned by the registry and full audit.

ikemenZss.validation.enabledLevels.description: Validation levels shown by the editor. Project convention and suggestion checks can be disabled without hiding engine errors.

ikemenZss.validation.disabledConventionR.description: Convention diagnostic codes to suppress, such as map-prefix or function-prefix. The project registry may also define this list.

enumDescriptions: Do not apply this author's opponent-availability convention.
Show this author's contextual team-mode advice as information.
Show this author's contextual team-mode advice as warnings.
ikemenZss.authorRules.opponentAvailabili.description: Optional rule belonging to the author selected by ikemenZss.authorName. Reviews actual P2, ... redirects and their persistent selected-opponent contract; it does not flag p2dist, p2life, or other p2-prefixed triggers. Off by default and inactive when no author is identified; this is not a game or engine rule. Rule ID: opponent-guard.

ikemenZss.impactPreview.maxFiles.description: Maximum text files inspected by a cross-file change-impact preview. The scan stops and reports truncation at this budget.

ikemenZss.impactPreview.maxFileBytes.description: Maximum size of one text file inspected by change-impact preview. Larger files are skipped and reported.

zssNavigator.maxWorkspaceFiles.description: Maximum number of ZSS files indexed by ZSS Navigator.

ikemenZss.updates.enabled.description: Check the latest official IKEMEN release and documentation sources when the configured interval has elapsed.

ikemenZss.updates.intervalDays.description: Days between automatic upstream checks. Checks run only while VS Code is open.

ikemenZss.updates.maxWorkspaceFiles.description: Maximum project files scanned for removed or renamed feature candidates.

ikemenZss.engine.showOtherVersions.description: Show discoverable features from other engine targets as disabled controls with their version requirement. This never enables unsupported output.

ikemenZss.engine.customKnowledgeSources.description: Optional HTTPS URLs for declarative custom-fork engine catalogs. Imported claims remain observed/unverified until checked locally; remote content is never executed.

ikemenZss.docs.offlineUpdatesEnabled.description: Show offline-library update actions alongside IKEMEN documentation checks. Downloads occur only after explicit confirmation.

ikemenZss.sizeboxReferenceXscale.description: Project reference xscale used by the contextual CNS sizebox converter.

ikemenZss.sizeboxReferenceYscale.description: Project reference yscale used by the contextual CNS sizebox converter.

ikemenZss.sprMake2Path.description: Optional SprMaker2 override. The Windows extension includes a ready-to-use copy and also honors a project's _development/tools/mugen-build copy.

ikemenZss.ikemenPath.description: Full path to Ikemen_GO.exe. When empty, the extension searches upward from the current file.

ikemenZss.defaultTrainingCharacter.description: Character DEF used when no character can be inferred from the current editor.

ikemenZss.defaultTrainingStage.description: Default stage used by the one-click mirror training launcher.

ikemenZss.additionalSourceExtensions.description: Additional filename extensions IKEMaker should include while discovering character files. Enter values such as cfg or inc without a leading dot. DEF-assigned files are recognized by their assigned role even when their extension is unconventional.

ikemenZss.additionalCodeExtensions.description: Optional extensions to display as character code when they are not assigned through a DEF. A DEF-assigned .txt state/options file is recognized automatically and does not need to be added here.

ikemenZss.testProfile.description: Active IKEMaker test profile. Universal tests remain available; game-specific tests require an explicit matching profile.

ikemenZss.stageRigMoveSpeed.description: World-coordinate pixels moved per tick by the development-only IKEMaker Stage Rig.

ikemenZss.stageRigFineMoveSpeed.description: Fine-adjustment speed used while holding game button X in the IKEMaker Stage Rig.

ikemenZss.stageRigFastMoveSpeed.description: Fast-traversal speed used while holding game button Y in the IKEMaker Stage Rig.

ikemenZss.sffDefaultFilename.description: Default output filename offered by the SFF build commands.

ikemenZss.sffProjectProfile.description: Remembered SFF build/animation profile. Default uses universal rules; projects and users may select or create another local profile.

ikemenZss.sffAutoSave.description: Automatically write direct SFF axis edits after a short delay. Keep disabled when the SprMaker2 manifest is authoritative.

ikemenZss.sffCreateBackups.description: Create timestamped backups before direct SFF or manifest edits. Disable only when external version control or another backup system is authoritative.
ikemenZss.sffCreateBackups.deprecationMessage: Automatic backups have been removed. Use Make Backup instead.

enumDescriptions: Display names, families, and aliases from the optional JNP Shared Fighter Standard.
Disable project numbering guidance while retaining custom names and native SFF/AIR validation.
ikemenZss.sffNamingProfile.description: Optional project-specific SFF numbering and naming profile. This never controls native IKEMEN/MUGEN validation.

ikemenZss.sffNumberingWarnings.description: Allow warnings produced specifically by the optional JNP numbering profile. Native SFF/AIR integrity checks remain enabled independently.

ikemenZss.defCommonPathMarkers.description: Folder-name markers treated as shared/common ownership when coloring file references in IKEMEN DEF files. References resolving outside the DEF folder and stcommon assignments are always shared.

ikemenZss.ffmpegPath.description: FFmpeg executable used for non-destructive SFF image resize, crop, rotation, channel, and aligned-export tools.

ikemenZss.imageEditorPath.description: Image editor executable used by the SFF Image Editor button. Leave blank to use the operating-system default; choose Photoshop.exe to open sprites in Photoshop.

ikemenZss.audioEditorPath.description: Audio editor executable used by the SND workspace. Leave blank to choose Audacity or another editor when first needed.

ikemenZss.sndMakerPath.description: Optional SndMaker override. The Windows extension includes a ready-to-use copy and also honors a project's _development/tools/mugen-build copy.

ikemenZss.sndCreateBackups.description: Create timestamped backups before sound profile, CommonFX DEF, manifest, or SND rebuild changes.
ikemenZss.sndCreateBackups.deprecationMessage: Automatic backups have been removed. Use Make Backup instead.

ikemenZss.paletteLibraryPath.description: Project folder containing reusable ACT or indexed PNG palettes shown in the SFF palette library. Configure per workspace folder so different games or characters can use separate libraries.

ikemenZss.animationStandardDiagnostics.description: Warn when an AIR file is missing actions from the selected character animation standard sets.

ikemenZss.animationStandardSets.description: Animation standard set IDs used by AIR diagnostics. Project requirement profiles may add stricter project-only standards separately.

ikemenZss.airLegacyReferenceDiagnostics.description: Show informational notices for explicitly archived or unreferenced legacy AIR actions whose sprites were intentionally removed from the SFF. Required and confirmed runtime references remain visible regardless of this setting.

ikemenZss.airAutoOpenWorkspace.description: Open the visual AIR companion workspace beside editable AIR code. Disable this to open it only through AIR: Open Animation & Layer Preview.

ikemenZss.characterHealth.checkUnknownPa.description: Compare legacy CNS and CMD controller options with the bundled IKEMEN GO 1.0 documentation. Disable for a custom dialect, or choose Custom / conservative in Character Health without changing this setting.

ikemenZss.characterHealth.allowedParamet.description: Additional project-defined legacy controller parameter names that Character Health should accept.

ikemenZss.characterHealth.ignoredRules.description: Character Health rule codes hidden for this workspace or project. Engine errors should only be suppressed after review.

ikemenZss.viewerSharedFxDefs.description: Additional native CommonFX DEF files for viewer navigation. Relative paths resolve from the character, then the game root and data folder. Character DEF fx assignments and sound profiles are also read. Duplicate prefixes require an explicit archive choice.

ikemenZss.autoSave.description: Automatically save sprite-axis edits and Workflow drafts. Off by default. Text editor autosave is configured separately with VS Code files.autoSave. Explicit Save and Apply actions still save.

ikemenZss.multipleAssetWorkspaces.description: Keep multiple Sprite, Animation and Sound workspaces open. When off, switching replaces the previous clean asset viewer and remembers its selection for this session. Unfinished edits block switching. Takes effect on the next asset open.
ikemenZss.multipleAssetWorkspaces.deprecationMessage: Use IKEMaker: Change Mode. This legacy preference is used only when no interface mode is configured.

ikemenZss.simpleAssetInterface.description: Start asset viewers with essential navigation, fewer side panels and collapsed advanced sections. All tools remain available through More and Layout. Saved customizations take precedence. Reopen viewers after changing.
ikemenZss.simpleAssetInterface.deprecationMessage: Use IKEMaker: Change Mode. This legacy preference is used only when no interface mode is configured.

enumDescriptions: Player tools only: roster, stages, stories, play, and focused character palette customization.
Player tools plus simplified creation and editing.
All features, advanced authoring and multiple viewers.
ikemenZss.interfaceMode.description: Choose the IKEMaker interface. New users are asked on first use; change anytime with IKEMaker: Change Mode.
